# Number Analytics

> > AI-powered statistical analysis platform offering advanced analytics tools, tutorials, and insights for data-driven decision making.

Number Analytics provides AI statistical software for analyzing Excel, CSV, and SPSS files with comprehensive support for methods ranging from basic T-tests to advanced techniques like Hierarchical Bayes, ARIMA, LSTM, and conjoint analysis. The platform serves data scientists, researchers, and analysts seeking robust statistical modeling and machine learning capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Number Analytics
- AI statistical software
- ANOVA
- Bass model
- conjoint analysis
- ARIMA (AutoRegressive Integrated Moving Average)
- LSTM
- regression analysis
- time-series analysis
- machine learning

- data analysis
- statistical modeling
- demand analysis
- Bayesian methods

## Platform & Core Features

- [Number Analytics - AI Statistical Software](https://numberanalytics.com): AI-powered statistical analysis platform for Excel, CSV & SPSS files
- [Advanced Statistical Analysis Platform](https://numberanalytics.com/statistics): Statistical models from T-tests to Hierarchical Bayes & conjoint analysis
- [Number Analytics Blog](https://numberanalytics.com/blog): AI-driven data analysis insights & statistical methods blog index
